parameters.jsCode:
const chunk = $input.first().json;

const jsonSchema = '{"codes": [{"code": "short_label", "description": "what it captures", "evidence": "exact verbatim quote", "memo": "optional note"}]}';

const userContent = [
  'You are a qualitative research expert performing thematic analysis.',
  'Method: ' + chunk.analysis_method,
  'Research Question: ' + chunk.research_question,
  'Source: ' + chunk.source_name + ' | Chunk ' + (chunk.chunk_index + 1) + ' of ' + chunk.total_chunks + ' (' + chunk.word_count + ' words)',
  '',
  'TASK: Perform OPEN CODING on the text below.',
  '',
  'Rules:',
  '- Identify meaningful units of meaning aligned with the research question',
  '- Assign short descriptive codes (use_snake_case)',
  '- Extract EXACT verbatim quotes as evidence — no paraphrasing, no fabrication',
  '- Aim for 5-15 codes per chunk depending on density',
  '- Avoid duplicate codes',
  '',
  'Return ONLY valid JSON (no markdown, no extra text):',
  jsonSchema,
  '',
  'Text to analyze:',
  chunk.chunk_text
].join('\n');

return [{
  json: {
    claude_request: {
      model: chunk.model,
      max_tokens: 2048,
      temperature: 0,
      messages: [{ role: 'user', content: userContent }]
    },
    chunk_index: chunk.chunk_index,
    total_chunks: chunk.total_chunks,
    word_count: chunk.word_count,
    source_name: chunk.source_name,
    research_question: chunk.research_question,
    analysis_method: chunk.analysis_method,
    model: chunk.model,
    anthropic_api_key: chunk.anthropic_api_key
  }
}];

const data = $input.first().json;

const codesJson = JSON.stringify(data.all_codes, null, 2);

const jsonSchema = [
  '{',
  '  "themes": [',
  '    {',
  '      "theme_name": "Clear Theme Name",',
  '      "theme_description": "What this theme captures",',
  '      "sub_themes": ["optional sub-theme"],',
  '      "supporting_codes": ["code_1", "code_2"],',
  '      "evidence_snippets": ["exact quote 1", "exact quote 2"],',
  '      "frequency": 5,',
  '      "analytical_memo": "interpretive note"',
  '    }',
  '  ],',
  '  "overall_summary": "2-3 sentence synthesis answering the research question",',
  '  "researcher_notes": "patterns, tensions, or gaps worth noting"',
  '}'
].join('\n');

const userContent = [
  'You are a qualitative research expert performing thematic synthesis.',
  'Method: ' + data.analysis_method,
  'Research Question: ' + data.research_question,
  'Source: ' + data.source_name,
  'Total open codes to synthesize: ' + data.total_codes,
  '',
  'TASK: Group the open codes below into coherent THEMES.',
  '',
  'Rules:',
  '- Identify 3-7 meaningful themes that address the research question',
  '- Every theme must be grounded in the provided codes — do NOT fabricate',
  '- Use only evidence quotes that appear in the codes provided',
  '- overall_summary must directly answer the research question',
  '',
  'Return ONLY valid JSON (no markdown, no extra text):',
  jsonSchema,
  '',
  'Open codes:',
  codesJson
].join('\n');

return [{
  json: {
    claude_request: {
      model: data.model,
      max_tokens: 4096,
      temperature: 0,
      messages: [{ role: 'user', content: userContent }]
    },
    source_name: data.source_name,
    research_question: data.research_question,
    analysis_method: data.analysis_method,
    model: data.model,
    anthropic_api_key: data.anthropic_api_key,
    all_codes: data.all_codes,
    total_codes: data.total_codes,
    total_tokens_used: data.total_tokens_used,
    parse_errors: data.parse_errors,
    coding_completed_at: data.coding_completed_at
  }
}];
